documents.title: Update On Proposed Investment In M/S. Siravit Ceramics Private Limited
Board Meeting Intimation for Considering Unaudited Financial Results For Quarter And Half-Year Ended 30Th September, 2026
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Management reported a 24% growth in sales value and a moderate 3% volume growth for Q1 FY27, impacted by production shutdowns in Morbi. EBITDA margins expanded to 11.6% due to higher capacity utilization at stand-alone plants (reaching 83%) and improved performance in joint ventures. The company announced a 9+ million square meter plant in the South requiring a capex of approximately INR220 crores, alongside debottlenecking across existing facilities. Management expressed a positive outlook, anticipating mid-single-digit volume growth and sustainable, potentially higher EBITDA margins. Somany Ceramics reported a strong performance for Q1 FY27 with consolidated revenue growing 24% year-on-year to INR 744 crore and EBITDA margin improving to 11.6%.

guidance.claim: The company expects mid-single-digit volume growth for the year.
Management targets achieving EBITDA margins of 12% and more.
guidance.quote: Yes, absolutely. That's the target that we achieve 12% and more.

guidance.claim: Management guided to improve EBITDA margin by at least 1.5% or more from the current base.
guidance.quote: Now for the guidance. Now the caveat is there's no further shocks geopolitically. But otherwise, our guidance is to improve EBITDA margin from here by at least 1.5% or more.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand in May and June was quite decent, and July has been reasonable despite rains in many regions.
demand_outlook.quote: Other than that, the demand of May and June has been pretty decent. July also has been not bad considering that there's been rains in many parts of the country.

demand_outlook.claim: Management states that current demand is perfectly fine.
demand_outlook.quote: But other than that, the demand is perfectly fine.

demand_outlook.claim: Management remains optimistic about the industry's growth prospects supported by sustained demand from housing, infrastructure, and renovation segments.
demand_outlook.quote: Looking ahead, we remain optimistic about the industry’s growth prospects, supported by sustained demand from housing, infrastructure, and renovation segments.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic demand saw a gradual improvement in January and February.
demand_outlook.quote: So as far as the quarter is concerned, the domestic demand saw a gradual improvement during January and Feb on account of increased domestic demand reducing the pressure on -- from reducing the pressure from exports.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that sanitaryware grew by 8% for the entire year.
demand_outlook.quote: Sanitaryware has done fairly well. We've grown by 8% for the entire year, and we have closed the figure at INR320 crores, up from INR296 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The company announced setting up a 9-plus million square meter plant in the South.
capex_expansion.quote: Because of that, we have announced setting up a 9 million square meter plant -- 9-plus million square meter plant in the South, which would be up and ready by in the next 12 to 15 months.

capex_expansion.claim: The new plant in the South has a potential revenue of approximately INR350 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: This would give us a potential revenue of about INR350 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: Capacity is being augmented by 4 million to 5 million in existing lines across Bahadurgarh, Gujarat, Morbi, and the South.
capex_expansion.quote: Other than that, we are taking many more steps, which are all work in progress to augment further capacity by about 4 million to 5 million in our existing lines in Bahadurgarh in -- which is in Haryana and in Gujarat and in Morbi and also in the South.

capex_expansion.claim: The total capex outlay from now to the end of FY27 is approximately INR275 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: So from now to '27 end, we have already looked at approximately INR275 crores outlay, which includes the INR220 crores plant plus balancing equipment in various other plants and some more balancing equipment in the Bathware, sanitaryware plant.

capex_expansion.claim: The company announced a new manufacturing facility with an annual capacity of approximately 9 million+ sqm of Glazed Vitrified Tiles to cater to the growing Southern market.
capex_expansion.quote: To cater to the growing Southern market, the Company has announced a new manufacturing facility with an annual capacity of approximately 9 million+ sqm. of Glazed Vitrified Tiles.

capex_expansion.claim: Management expects routine capex and balancing equipment to be contained within INR70 crores to INR80 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: So everything will be contained in the INR70 crores, INR80 crores of routine capex and balancing equipment to make our assets more value-added or more -- towards more capacity utilization.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins for the quarter increased by 3.6% to 11.6% due to operational efficiencies and capacity utilization.
margins_costs.quote: As a result of capacity utilization, our EBITDA margins have gone up on operational efficiencies, both on capacity utilization in our plants and also on the JV performances. So EBITDA margins go up by 3.6% to 11.6% for the quarter.

margins_costs.claim: Natural gas prices have increased between 16% and 18%.
margins_costs.quote: So the current price increase has been between 16% and 18%.

margins_costs.claim: The company's blended natural gas price stands at about INR68.
margins_costs.quote: Yes. So our blended price comes in at about INR68.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin improved to 11.6% driven by product mix improvement and continued focus on operational efficiencies.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin improved to 11.6%, driven by product mix improvement and continued focus on operational efficiencies.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA improved significantly by 3.2% in Q4 and about 1% for the entire year.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA improved quite significantly, 3.2% in Q4 and about 1% in the entire year.

margins_costs.claim: Gas pricing for Morbi is currently at INR74 plus a 6% ballpark for May.
margins_costs.quote: So, the Morbi pricing is currently -- for May, the pricing is INR74 plus 6% ballpark.

orders_capacity.claim: Stand-alone capacity utilization increased from 72% in the same quarter last year to 83%.
orders_capacity.quote: On a stand-alone basis from 72% capacity utilization to 83%, which is a major, major increase, and that has led to margin.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization was largely flat, moving from approximately 80% to 79% for the year.
orders_capacity.quote: Capacity utilization was largely flat from approximately 80% to 79%.

orders_capacity.claim: Net new dealer additions across India were 200, taking the total dealer showrooms to about 3,100.
orders_capacity.quote: The net dealer addition has been very strong this year. We've added net new additions of 200 dealers across India, taking the total dealer showrooms to about 3,100.

capital_allocation.claim: Working capital days decreased from 17 to 12 days.
capital_allocation.quote: Working capital days also have come down from 17 to 12 days.

capital_allocation.claim: About 65% to 70% of the capex outlay will be funded through internal accruals.
capital_allocation.quote: So again, we're not putting pressure on the balance sheet at all. And the loan which will be taken, the small loan, which will be taken in the joint venture with no corporate guarantee from Somany side.

capital_allocation.claim: Working capital improved, marginally lower by 4 days to 9 days.
capital_allocation.quote: Working capital, we've done fairly well. It's marginally lower by 4 days to 9 days.

risks_headwinds.claim: Exports from Morbi were down by 50% to 60% from the peak due to geopolitical reasons.
risks_headwinds.quote: The only negative in the quarter has been from a Morbi perspective is exports has been down due to geopolitical reasons, the export is down a good 50%, 60% from the peak.

risks_headwinds.claim: Gas prices have been extremely volatile every month.
risks_headwinds.quote: The gas price has been extremely volatile. I had mentioned that in the earnings call for the FY26, but the gas price since then has been extremely volatile. Every month, there have been a small increases in gas price.

risks_headwinds.claim: The quarter witnessed supply-side disruptions in the Morbi cluster due to fuel shortages, labour unavailability, and elevated gas prices resulting in production curtailments.
risks_headwinds.quote: The quarter witnessed supply-side disruptions in the Morbi cluster due to fuel shortages, labour unavailability, and elevated gas prices, resulting in production curtailments across the industry.

risks_headwinds.claim: March was an aberration month because of geopolitical circumstances, causing exports to stop.
risks_headwinds.quote: Obviously, March was a very aberration month because of the various circumstances which played out geopolitically.

risks_headwinds.claim: Gas prices have increased very significantly following the war.
risks_headwinds.quote: Gas price, as you all know, has increased very significantly, which we can talk about that.

risks_headwinds.claim: There is a major labor shortage in Morbi.
risks_headwinds.quote: The situation currently in Morbi is that whoever has started up is facing a little bit of challenge with labor. There a major, major, major labor shortage in Morbi.

management_commitments.claim: The 9-plus million square meter plant in the South will be operational in the next 12 to 15 months.
management_commitments.quote: Because of that, we have announced setting up a 9 million square meter plant -- 9-plus million square meter plant in the South, which would be up and ready by in the next 12 to 15 months.

management_commitments.claim: Capacity additions across existing lines will be ready from mid-quarter 3 and completely in place in quarter 4.
management_commitments.quote: All put together, we will be adding another 4 million to 5 million for the mid -- this will be ready from mid-quarter 3 and would be completely in place in quarter 4.

management_commitments.claim: Management maintains that the EBITDA margins delivered in the quarter will be sustained and improved.
management_commitments.quote: And we maintain that the EBITDA margins delivered in this quarter would be maintained, and we are trying to better our EBITDA margins, which we have delivered in last quarter and on this quarter.

management_commitments.claim: The company has set an aggressive double-digit target for sanitaryware growth.
management_commitments.quote: Sanitaryware has done fairly well. We've grown by 8% for the entire year, and we have closed the figure at INR320 crores, up from INR296 crores. And this year, we've taken a very aggressive target, a very aggressive double-digit target.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
